title: Compliance bulletin: prescription-monitoring database check age and withheld fills
content:
**Compliance office bulletin — Prescriptions & Renewals controlled renewals.**

**Rule.** The database-check withholding follows the calendar days since the latest prescription-monitoring database check: more than 60 days withholds 2 fills; more than 30 but no more than 60 days withholds 1 fill; 30 days or fewer withholds none.

**Definitions.**
- *Latest database check* — the date of the latest check of the state prescription-monitoring database (OARRS) recorded on this prescription.
- *Calendar days since* — the number of calendar days by which the renewal date falls after that check date.
- A prescription with no recorded database check is in the same position as one last checked more than 60 days before.

**Table.**

| Days since the latest database check on the renewal date | Fills withheld |
|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | 0 |
| 31 to 60 | 1 |
| 61 or more | 2 |
| no recorded check | 2 |

**Edges (hypothetical).** A check 30 days before the renewal date withholds nothing; 31 days withholds 1 fill; 60 days withholds 1 fill; 61 days withholds 2 fills.
